She sits in shock, with fear visible on her face, as if she still cannot believe what has suddenly happened to her. The Nepal Army deserves immense appreciation for risking their own lives to save people trapped in these dangerous conditions. The devastation in Nepal is truly heartbreaking. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Kerosene stove fire broke out today at Hotel Good Luck at 10 AM, the heavy wooden insulation inside lodges at high altitudes can make flames spread within minutes. With village water pipes frozen deep under snow, 100+ locals, guides and trekkers fought the flames by hand to save rest of the property. Zero casualties, and neighboring lodges immediately took in every stranded guest and helped them. A massive reminder of the risks local lodge owners carry, and how Khumbu community always backs each other up. #nepal #trekkinginnepal
